Home/Capabilities

What we build, and how it connects to what you already run.

Four capabilities, one engineer accountable for all of them. Most engagements combine two or three around a single workflow.

  • 01

    Custom internal tools and portals

    Borrower, investor and client portals. Deal and loan pipelines. Review queues your team works from every morning. Built around your process instead of a template.

    Most firms run their real process in email, spreadsheets and a shared drive, next to systems that were never set up to match it. We build the missing screen: the portal a borrower or LP logs into, the queue an analyst works, the dashboard a partner checks before committee.

    Borrower document portals, LP onboarding portals, deal pipelines, exception queues
  • 02

    System and core integrations

    Data moves between the CRM, core, property-management and fund-admin systems you already pay for. Nobody re-keys it, and there is no new platform to adopt.

    We connect through vendor APIs where your license allows it, and through scheduled exports and reports where it does not. Either way the record lands in your system of record, with a log of what moved and when.

    CRM sync, core and LOS extracts, property-management reports, fund-admin exports
  • 03

    Document and underwriting automation

    Offering memoranda, rent rolls, T-12s, tax returns and financial statements become structured data, then your model, memo or signed PDF.

    Extraction is the easy part. The work is in the checks: totals that must reconcile, values that must agree across documents, and a reviewer who sees exactly which page each number came from before anything is accepted.

    Rent roll and T-12 extraction, financial spreading, credit and IC memo drafts, pre-filled signed PDFs
  • 04

    Practical AI workflows

    Extraction, drafting and triage with a person reviewing the output, every figure linked to its source page, and a full audit log.

    We use AI where reading and drafting are the bottleneck, and plain deterministic code everywhere else. Anything a model produces goes through validation rules and a human reviewer before it reaches a system of record or a client.

    Lease abstraction, memo first drafts, deal-flow triage, quarterly letter drafts
Our position on AI

We don’t just use AI. We implement it where it matters.

A person reviews every output

AI drafts and extracts. Your analyst, credit officer or operations lead approves. Nothing reaches a system of record on its own.

Every figure traces to its source

Each extracted value links back to the document and page it came from, so a reviewer can check it in seconds.

Private and zero-retention options

Run models in your own cloud, or through configurations where the provider does not retain your documents.
